newsitem.title: USA: Starbucks July same-store sales up 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks July same-store sales up 7 pct.

text.p: Starbucks Corp reported net sales of $80.3 million for the four-week period ending July 27, 1997, up 39 percent from $57.9 million a year ago.
On a comparable store sales basis, sales rose seven percent for the four weeks ending July 27, 1997, as compared to the same four-week period in fiscal 1996.

For the 43 weeks ending July 27, 1997, consolidated net revenues were $776.5 million, up 39 percent from consolidated net revenues of $558.0 million for the same period in fiscal 1996. Comparable store sales rose five percent for the 43-week period ending July 27, 1997, as compared to the same 43-week period in fiscal 1996.
